summary: Trekor Metals Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about its Yellowhead Copper Project. The release announces the submission of a Detailed Project Description to the BC Environmental Assessment Office and the release of an economic impact study. No special-situation transaction is mentioned — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing is a routine project update. There are no deal terms.
